body.message:
We can arrange the viewing for today at 3:00 PM. Kindly share your Emirates ID or passport copy in advance so we can arrange the viewing access accordingly.

If you like the apartment after the viewing, you may proceed with the security deposit payment in cash at that time to secure the unit.

Regarding the refund process, we have coordinate with our team, and the security deposit refund will be processed upon check-out, provided there are no damages to the apartment.
